scope: Independent read-only review of existing companion, OptiLock reference, and installed native config; candidate installer pending.

findings.title: VPK wildcard removal would delete official assets
findings.evidence: Installed citadel contains pak01_000 through pak01_322, pak01_dir, and shader VPKs.
findings.requiredAction: Never remove VPK files by extension or broad glob. Identify custom packages individually; preserve official assets.

findings.title: Existing low settings leave gain unproven
findings.evidence: Installed video.txt already lowers most expensive graphics features and has native 1920x1080 scale 1, AA/upscaling disabled, particle fallback 5, texture mip bias 4.
findings.requiredAction: Build candidates, verify acceptance, and perform matched warmed A/B frame-time measurements before asserting additional gain.

findings.title: OptiLock's implementation relies on mod and game-description edits
findings.evidence: Its README describes replacing gameinfo.gi and including a modded VPK, plus a mip-bias lighting-fix mod dependency above 4.
findings.requiredAction: Keep gameinfo and asset packages intact; use native settings and normally editable cfg commands only.

findings.title: Generic async networking tweak contradicts installed game evidence
findings.evidence: gameinfo.gi explicitly sets cl_async_usercmd_send false because early prediction is unsupported; OptiLock sets it true then false elsewhere.
findings.requiredAction: Exclude networking, prediction, tick simulation, and guessed threading tweaks from the recommended FPS profile.

findings.title: Config-file presence does not establish runtime value
findings.evidence: machine_convars.vcfg has fps_max 400, video.txt has setting.fps_max 0, and video.txt has a duplicate particle-detail key.
findings.requiredAction: Check parsing, mutability, range, normal configuration order, and runtime values.

findings.title: Companion idle sample is not an FPS baseline
findings.evidence: Existing docs label the 0.0000% CPU sample as nonforeground idle work; active OCR/capture FPS effect is unmeasured.
findings.requiredAction: Hold companion and overlays constant or close them for controlled benchmarking; do not infer zero capture overhead.

findings.title: Reported Valve mod/cache deletion quote remains unverified
findings.evidence: Checked official City Never Sleeps, forum changelog, and Rat King release posts do not contain that exact advice.
findings.requiredAction: Retain mod-free task constraint; avoid attributing a broad deletion directive to Valve without the actual primary post.

findings.title: High process priority and affinity cuts require measurements
findings.evidence: Microsoft Scheduling Priorities guidance warns of starving lower-priority work and system-thread disruption at realtime.
findings.requiredAction: Leave default game priority/affinity for recommended profile; no registry/OS optimizer bundle.
